# The Psychology Square

> The Psychology Square is a clinical psychology practice based in Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan, offering individual and couples therapy (online and in person), corporate mental health services, research/statistical analysis support, and psychology tutoring. The site also publishes free psychology articles, assessments, and worksheets.

This file follows the llms.txt convention to help AI systems understand and reference this site's content accurately. See our robots.txt for machine-readable content-use permissions (search and AI-answer citation are allowed; AI training is not).

## Services

- [Therapy](https://thepsychologysquare.com/services/therapy/): Individual and couples therapy, online and in-person in Lahore.
- [Corporate & Workplace Mental Health](https://thepsychologysquare.com/services/corporate/): Employee assistance, workplace training, manager support, and organizational assessments.
- [Research & Statistical Analysis](https://thepsychologysquare.com/services/research-analysis/): Statistical and research analysis support for psychology research.
- [Psychology Tutoring](https://thepsychologysquare.com/services/tutoring/): Tutoring for O Level, A Level, BS, and MS psychology students.

## Resources

- [Articles](https://thepsychologysquare.com/articles/): Psychology articles covering anxiety, depression, ADHD, autism, neuroscience, and more.
- [Assessments](https://thepsychologysquare.com/resources/assessments/): Free psychological screening scales (e.g. GAD-7, PHQ-9, Vanderbilt ADHD).
- [Worksheets](https://thepsychologysquare.com/resources/worksheets/): Free and paid therapy worksheets (e.g. cost-benefit analysis, locus of control).

## Team

- [Team](https://thepsychologysquare.com/team/): Meet our clinical psychologists.

## Contact

- [Contact / Booking](https://thepsychologysquare.com/contact/): Get in touch or book a session.

## Notes

- All clinical content is written or reviewed by licensed clinical psychologists.
- For citation or reference in AI-generated answers, please link back to the source page on thepsychologysquare.com.
